en.joke: My boss said 'we're a family.' That explains why I can't afford rent and they still expect me to work for free on weekends.
en.explanation: It uses dark humor to satirize corporate 'family' rhetoric, contrasting it with the reality of employee exploitation and low wages.

people.name: Rondell Sheridan
people.extract: Rondell Jerome Sheridan is an American actor, comedian and television director, best known for his role of Victor Baxter in the Disney Channel sitcom That's So Raven, as well as its later spin-offs Cory in the House and Raven's Home. Sheridan is an alumnus of Marquette University. Sheridan also starred as Dr. Ron Aimes on the NBC/UPN sitcom Minor Adjustments.
highlights: Best known as Victor Baxter in That's So Raven.
Appeared in Cory in the House and Raven's Home.
Starred as Dr. Ron Aimes on Minor Adjustments.

people.name: Gerty Cori
people.extract: Gerty Theresa Cori was a Czech and American biochemist who in 1947 was the third woman to win a Nobel Prize in science, and the first woman to be awarded the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine, for her role in the "discovery of the course of the catalytic conversion of glycogen".
highlights: Third woman to win a Nobel Prize in science.
First woman to win Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine.

people.name: Stylianos Gonatas
people.extract: Stylianos Gonatas was an officer of the Hellenic Army, Venizelist politician, and Prime Minister of Greece from 1922 to 1924.
